thread:
maria-sales: Heads-up — ACME committed to a demo tomorrow. Need an internal quick runbook to stand up a POC: Hosted API keys immediately, a tiny Dedicated fallback pool, and VPC peering for customer data. 48h SLA. Who can own?

sam-eng: I can own infra. Draft runbook (short):
- 0) Confirm SSO/SCIM with customer
- 1) Create hosted scoped API key: tenant=acme-poc, scopes=chat,embeddings, ttl=72h
- 2) Request Dedicated fallback: 2x small GPUs, min_replicas=2, tag sales:acme_poc
- 3) Start VPC peering worksheet: peering request -> accept -> route updates -> SG limits
- 4) KMS + audit: KMS owner, ACLs, audit_retention=90d (per ACME ask)
- 5) Share creds via vault link and rotate after demo

jordan-se: Commands/snippets:
- Mint temp key:
```
redwood-cli keys create --tenant acme-poc --scope chat,embed --ttl 72h --note "acme poc temp"
```
- Dedicated request form (send to infra queue):
```
resource: dedicated_pool
name: acme-poc-fallback
gpus: 2
min_replicas: 2
tags: ["sales:acme_poc","trial"]
```
- Smoke test after allocation: POST /v1/chat with short prompt, GET /v1/embeddings sample.

devops-bot: infra#5120 created -> provisioning queued. ETA ~4h for GPU allocation. Will update.

iris-security: Security blockers before peering: 1) Confirm SSO method (SAML + SCIM?) 2) KMS key ownership and decrypt ACLs 3) Required audit retention window (30/90/365). Put answers in https://confluence/redwood/sec/poctrials

maria-sales: ACME confirmed SAML+SCIM and wants 90d audit. Sam, can you add to infra ticket?

sam-eng: Done — infra#5120 updated with SSO=SAML+SCIM, audit_retention=90d, and ACME CIDRs. Also attached ACME ops contact.

akshay-accounts: Pricing note for the deal team: estimate monthly run-rate for demo if they use ~100k tokens + 2-GPU fallback ≈ $4.7k/month. Offer 15% off for a 6mo reserved commit. Note: VPC egress may add costs; flag in T&Cs.

jordan-se: Operational handoff checklist:
- Generate key, publish to customer via vault link (never Slack)
- Validate sample chat/embeddings calls and share results
- Once Dedicated is up, run health endpoint and small prompt against fallback
- Rotate temp key after handoff/demo complete

sam-eng: VPC peering short steps: initiate peering request -> ACME accepts -> update both route tables -> create dedicated ENIs for private nodes -> tighten security groups to customer CIDRs + only HTTPS and necessary mgmt ports. If mutual TLS required, coordinate certs.

maria-sales: Action owners recap:
- sam-eng: infra#5120 (Dedicated + VPC) owner
- jordan-se: mint temp key + smoke test snippet
- iris-security: confirm KMS ACLs and final questionnaire entry
- akshay-accounts: provisional pricing blurb for proposal
I'll update ACME with ETA and next steps. Thanks all :thumbsup:
